::: {.callout-note}
## Source inspected
The public VCH service page was read on 20 September 2026. A site search in this pass did **not** find current or archived VCH pages that name ECPM / Enhanced Consumer Participation Model. This page is institutional survival of **CSIL**, not of the ECPM name.
:::

## Identification

| Element | As seen |
| --- | --- |
| Title | Choice in Support for Independent Living |
| Issuer | Vancouver Coastal Health |
| URL | <https://www.vch.ca/en/service/choice-support-independent-living> |
| Title wording | VCH uses “Choice in **Support**” (singular) in the page title; body text also expands CSIL and links a “Choice in Supports” guidebook |

## Annotation

The page defines CSIL as “an alternative method for delivering home support for clients who can direct their care” and “an individualized funding approach.” It states that as a CSIL employer the client “receive[s] money from VCH to hire, manage, and pay [their] own home support staff,” and lists recruiting, hiring, training, scheduling and supervising. It links a CSIL handbook/guidebook and the provincial CSIL page.

What this page can support: VCH currently administers CSIL as a named self-directed home-support option. What it cannot support: ECPM as a living VCH program name; any founding year; any statement that ECPM “survives” institutionally under that acronym.

Related VCH mental-health “Consumer Involvement and Initiatives” pages use “consumer” in a different program family; they were not treated as ECPM evidence.

## Open questions

- Whether historical Vancouver Health Department / GVHSS / VCH intranet or retired PDFs still use the ECPM name.
- Exact bibliographic details of the linked CSIL guidebook (not separately catalogued in this pass).
